title: Knotted Satin Sleeveless Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This satin bridesmaid dress brings a sleek, modern feel with its one shoulder neckline and softly sculpted silhouette. The gathered waist detail helps define the figure, while the smooth maxi skirt falls beautifully with every step. A lovely choice for bridal parties, formal weddings, and elegant evening celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side left zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
